HENSON SMITH / BEHIND THE MUSIC

CLARKSVILLE
TO THE UK.

Henson Smith’s story runs between America and England. With an American military dad and an English mum who taught music, his childhood meant moving around before settling in the UK as a young teenager.

Music was part of the family landscape. In his early days, he signed to an independent label, played supporting slots, and toured around Asia as part of a hip-hop troupe.

These days, the focus is on writing and producing songs: finding something worth saying, getting lost in the process, and enjoying the music.

Fame and fortune aren’t the ambition. Peace and enjoyment are. Keeping his face out of the spotlight leaves room for the songs—and for a life beyond them.

“Fame and fortune is my worst nightmare.”

NO FACE. ALL SOUND. ROOM TO LIVE.
